reason: M2 is one of the cross-coupled PMOS load devices between net15 and net43; removing it halves the PMOS positive feedback but leaves M3 and the NMOS cross-coupled network (M7/M8) to provide regeneration.
impact_estimate: Minor: reduces regeneration strength and may slightly slow decision and degrade noise margin, but core comparator functionality is retained at moderate speeds.

reason: M7 forms one branch of the NMOS cross-coupling between net15, net43 and the intermediate node net20; with M8 still present, there remains a regenerative path and the main differential comparison can still occur.
impact_estimate: Minor to moderate: weakens regeneration on one side and can introduce a small offset/asymmetry, but the latch and decision behavior remain qualitatively intact.

reason: M10 is an NMOS that precharges net20 toward VDD under VCLK1; removing it eliminates an active precharge for this internal node, but the node can still be driven/discharged through the input transistors and latch network.
impact_estimate: Moderate: dynamic performance and reset behavior degrade (especially at high clock rates), yet for slower operation the comparator can still resolve input differences using the remaining devices.
